Savage Beastfly: health, attacks and hits to kill

A boss fight in Hollow Knight: Silksong against Savage Beastfly, in Chapel of the Beast and Far Fields. The Hunter's Journal says: "Angered, adult Beastfly with a weighty body and a thickened hardshell mask."

Fought 2 times: Savage Beastfly (Chapel of the Beast), 550 health and 1,100 black-threaded, in Act 3; Savage Beastfly (Far Fields), 650 health and 1,300 black-threaded, in Act 3.

With the Needle alone (a Hunter's Crest with no Tools or modifiers), with the Needle, Sharpened Needle, Shining Needle, Hivesteel Needle and Pale Steel Needle: Savage Beastfly (Chapel of the Beast): 69, 50, 43, 37 and 33 slashes; Savage Beastfly (Far Fields): 82, 60, 50, 44 and 39 slashes.

With the Hunter's Crest, a slash every 0.41 s (the game's own pace, from its files): with the Pale Steel Needle, 13.1 s of nonstop slashing.

Attacks, as the wiki names them (the game doesn't): Sweep, Slam, Summon.

Staggered after 11 hits.

Phases, from the game's own files: Savage Beastfly (Chapel of the Beast): phase 2 at 248 health (45%); Savage Beastfly (Far Fields): phase 2 at 293 health (45%).

Reward: Beast and Horn Fragment.

This page opens the damage calculator with this boss picked: with your save or your build, each of your attacks' damage, how many it takes, and what each of its attacks does to you.

Questions

What is Savage Beastfly's health in Silksong?

Fought 2 times: Savage Beastfly (Chapel of the Beast), 550 health and 1,100 black-threaded, in Act 3; Savage Beastfly (Far Fields), 650 health and 1,300 black-threaded, in Act 3.

How many hits does it take to beat Savage Beastfly?

It depends on your Needle and your Tools: with the Needle alone, from 69 slashes with the Needle to 33 with the Pale Steel Needle. For your exact build, open the calculator on this page.
